name: publicWeb_sendChatMessage
description: A web member posts one chat message (E9.F7.S15) through the app's own send SPs, chosen by @kind: 'run' → hcapp_sendEventMessage, 'kennel' → hcapp_sendKennelMessage, 'room' → hcapp_sendRoomMessage, 'dm' → hcapp_sendDirectMessage (E9.F1.S7). The wrapper only resolves public ids (run/kennel must be live) and checks the request is well formed; auth, membership/room/thread gates, content length (4,000) and message kind are the inner SP's. The token must be signed for the inner SP the kind selects. @messageId is the client's id, so a retried post cannot double up. Because the inner SPs answer with the message and push audiences rather than an envelope, the wrapper appends { success 1 } when the message row exists. Reachable only through PublicWebAdminApi behind HC_INTERNAL_SECRET; the API sends no push for a web post. Since 2026-10-13 the public-web API drops every FcmToken column before replying, so the push-recipient rowsets reach the web server without device tokens (positions and row counts unchanged).

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The calling browser's HC.Device id (the browser is a registered device). No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Device-bound token signed for the inner SP @kind selects (hcapp_sendEventMessage / hcapp_sendKennelMessage / hcapp_sendRoomMessage / hcapp_sendDirectMessage). No SQL default.

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: Client-generated id (idempotency key). Required; no SQL default.

parameters.name: messageContent
parameters.description: The text, or the photo URL / location for kinds 1 / 2. MAX so nothing is cut silently; the inner SP refuses over 4,000. Blank → 1230. No SQL default.

parameters.name: messageKind
parameters.description: 0 text (default), 1 photo, 2 location (E9.F1.S11/S12); checked by the inner SP.

parameters.name: replyToMessageId
parameters.description: Message being quoted (E9.F1.S21); the inner SP checks it is in the same thread.

rowsets.name: WrapperRefusal
rowsets.description: Wrapper refusal, before any EXEC: bad or NULL-resolving @kind / public id / @roomType / @threadId, NULL @messageId or blank @messageContent → { success 0, errorCode 1230, errorType 12 }, logged to HC.ErrorLog.
Follows WrapperRefusal: errorTitle 'Not found', errorUserMessage 'That chat could not be found.'

rowsets.name: ErrorResult
rowsets.description: [kind 'run'] From hcapp_sendEventMessage: Returned alone, then RETURN, on: auth failure (codes/types from ValidateAppAuth); 1261 messageId NULL / eventId NULL / content empty / releasability missing or zero (errorType 12 — not the HC6 standard 2); 1264 content over 4,000 (2); 1265 bad message kind (2); 1263 sender not a kennel member/follower nor on the run (3); 9999 unhandled error from the CATCH (5). Because the TRY spans past the COMMIT (see code smells), 9999 can also follow an already-committed insert.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: Unique ID of the HC.ErrorLog entry.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: From ValidateAppAuth on auth failure; 12 for 1261; 2 for 1264/1265; 3 for 1263; 5 for 9999.

rowsets.name: InsertedMessage
rowsets.description: [kind 'run'] From hcapp_sendEventMessage: On success: the just-inserted message, one row, for the sender's optimistic UI and the API's push body.

columns.name: EventId
columns.description: EventMessage.EventId. UNIQUEIDENTIFIER (was NVARCHAR in HC5) — breaking change.

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: Hasher.PublicHasherId of the sender (not the internal Hasher.id).

columns.name: UserDisplayName
columns.description: Hasher.DisplayName — persisted computed column (hash name or real name per preference).

columns.name: UserPhoto
columns.description: Hasher.Photo — URL of the sender's profile photo.

columns.name: MessageTitle
columns.description: DisplayName + ' - ' + EventMessage.MessageTitle (the EventName default when the caller passed NULL).

columns.name: MessageContent
columns.description: HC6.ChatMessagePreview(MessageKind, MessageContent): the text, or a photo/location placeholder. The API uses it as the push body — NOT the raw URL for a photo or location.

columns.name: MessageReleasabilityFlags
columns.description: EventMessage.MessageReleasabilityFlags. Column name corrected from the HC5 typo 'MessageRelesabilityFlags' — breaking change for any caller reading it by name.

columns.name: EventChatMessageCount
columns.description: Always 0 — hardcoded. Obsolete field retained for client compatibility.

columns.name: MessageType
columns.description: EventMessage.MessageType — 0 for a run thread (INT in the table, not NVARCHAR as the HC5 contract said).

rowsets.name: VisiblePushRecipients
rowsets.description: [kind 'run'] From hcapp_sendEventMessage: On success, API-only: one row per distinct FCM token with Buzz = 1 — effective bell 1, or 4 inside ±6 h of the run start, AND (the bell is set on the run itself, or HC6.RunChatTie says the run is personally theirs, or they are the kennel's GM/On-Sec). Audience base: HasherKennelMap rows for the run's kennel (not removed, hasher not removed), device live with a token and LastLogin within 180 days, not blocking the sender (HasherFriendMap.Ignore), effective bell in (1,3,4), and matching the releasability bits. The sender's own devices are included on purpose (the echo drives the delivered tick). May be empty.

columns.name: FcmToken
columns.description: Device.FcmToken — only non-null tokens are returned.

columns.name: BadgeTotal
columns.description: The recipient's unread chat total for the app icon (HC6.UserUnreadChatTotal); the API puts it in aps.badge / notification_count / data.BadgeTotal. Added 2026-09-28. NULL when no device with that token is on a build >= HC6.MinBuildForIconBadge() (older apps never lower the icon).

rowsets.name: SilentPushRecipients
rowsets.description: [kind 'run'] From hcapp_sendEventMessage: On success, API-only: tokens with Buzz = 0 and Silent = 1 — a data-only push so the badge moves without a notification: bell 3 (muted), bell 4 outside the window, or a kennel-bell-only hasher whose tie to the run is just the kennel (member or follower). A token that already appears in rowset 1 (another account on the same phone) is excluded via NOT EXISTS. May be empty.

columns.name: FcmToken
columns.description: Device.FcmToken — only non-null tokens are returned.

rowsets.description: [kind 'kennel'] From hcapp_sendKennelMessage: Returned alone, then RETURN, on: auth failure (codes/types from ValidateAppAuth); 1901 missing messageId/kennelId/content (errorType 2); 1902 content over 4,000 (2); 1903 bad message kind (2); 1933 unhandled error in the write transaction (5). The push-audience queries after the commit are NOT inside a TRY, so a failure there is a raw HTTP 500 after rowset 0 has been sent.

rowsets.name: InsertedMessage
rowsets.description: [kind 'kennel'] From hcapp_sendKennelMessage: On success: the just-inserted message, one row, for the sender's optimistic UI and the API's push body.

columns.name: PublicKennelId
columns.description: EventMessage.PublicKennelId, copied from Kennel.PublicKennelId at insert.

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: Hasher.PublicHasherId of the sender (not the internal id).

columns.name: MessageTitle
columns.description: DisplayName + ' - ' + EventMessage.MessageTitle ('' when none was given).

columns.name: MessageContent
columns.description: HC6.ChatMessagePreview(MessageKind, MessageContent): the text, or a photo/location placeholder. The API uses it as the push body — it is NOT the raw stored content for a photo or location.

columns.name: MessageReleasabilityFlags
columns.description: EventMessage.MessageReleasabilityFlags as stored (63 when the caller passed NULL).

columns.name: EventChatMessageCount
columns.description: Always 0 — kept for shape parity with hcapp_sendEventMessage.

columns.name: MessageType
columns.description: EventMessage.MessageType — 0 for a kennel thread (non-zero values name a global room).

columns.name: KennelShortName
columns.description: Kennel.KennelShortName, so the phone can title the thread a push opens. Added 2026-09-18.

rowsets.name: VisiblePushRecipients
rowsets.description: [kind 'kennel'] From hcapp_sendKennelMessage: On success: one row per distinct FCM token whose hasher's KennelNotificationPreference is 1 (on) or 4 (on before the run — treated as on, a kennel thread has no run window). Audience: HasherKennelMap rows for @kennelId, not removed, hasher not removed, device not removed with a token and LastLogin within 180 days, build >= HC6.MinBuildForChatPush() (TRY_CAST — '<unknown>' fails closed), not blocking the sender (HasherFriendMap.Ignore), and matching the releasability bits. The sender's own devices are included on purpose (the echo drives the delivered tick). May be empty.

columns.name: BadgeTotal
columns.description: HC6.UserUnreadChatTotal for the recipient — the app-icon badge the API puts in aps.badge / notification_count. NULL when no device with that token is on a build >= HC6.MinBuildForIconBadge() (older apps never lower the icon).

rowsets.name: SilentPushRecipients
rowsets.description: [kind 'kennel'] From hcapp_sendKennelMessage: On success: the same audience with KennelNotificationPreference 3 (on but muted) — a data-only push so the badge moves without a notification. Same columns as rowset 1. May be empty.

[kind 'room'] From hcapp_sendRoomMessage: Returned alone, then RETURN, on: auth failure (from ValidateAppAuth); 1941 missing roomType/messageId/content (errorType 2); 1942 content over 4,000 (errorType 2) — AND 1942 not admitted to the room (errorType 13; the same code is reused for two different refusals, only errorType tells them apart); 1944 bad message kind (2); 1943 unhandled error in the write transaction (5).

rowsets.name: Message
rowsets.description: [kind 'room'] From hcapp_sendRoomMessage: On success: the message in the shape the chat page already reads for kennel and event threads (flutter_chat_core). One row. UNCHANGED since 2026-09-13 apart from the additive messageKind and canDelete.

columns.name: id
columns.description: UPPER(EventMessage.id). Uppercase on purpose — the client lowercases on arrival (HcId).

columns.name: type
columns.description: Always 'text' — even for a photo or location; messageKind carries the kind.

columns.name: text
columns.description: EventMessage.MessageContent — the raw content (text, photo URL or map link).

columns.name: roomId
columns.description: Always the empty GUID 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 — a room has no id in this column; the client knows the room from the call it made.

columns.name: createdAt
columns.description: EventMessage.createdAt as Unix epoch milliseconds (DATEDIFF_BIG from 1970-01-01; createdAt is sysutcdatetime).

columns.name: authorFirstName
columns.description: Hasher.DisplayName (hash name or real name per preference).

columns.name: canDelete
columns.description: Always 1 — it is the sender's own message.

rowsets.name: PushDetail
rowsets.description: [kind 'room'] From hcapp_sendRoomMessage: On success, API ONLY (stripped before the reply): what the shim needs to build the push. One row. Inside the log-and-swallow TRY — absent, together with rowsets 2–3, if that section fails.

columns.name: RoomName
columns.description: HC6.ChatRoomCatalog().RoomName (LEFT JOIN — NULL only for a room not in the catalog, which the gate already refused).

columns.name: MessageTitle
columns.description: RoomName + ' — ' + DisplayName (NULL if RoomName is NULL).

columns.name: MessageContent
columns.description: HC6.ChatMessagePreview(MessageKind, MessageContent) — the push body, not the raw URL for a photo/location.

rowsets.name: VisiblePushRecipients
rowsets.description: [kind 'room'] From hcapp_sendRoomMessage: On success, API ONLY: one row per distinct FCM token of a hasher admitted by HC6.UserMayEnterChatRoom whose room ParticipationState is 0 (no row = 0). Device must be live (removed 0, token present, LastLogin within 180 days, build >= HC6.MinBuildForChatPush() via TRY_CAST — fails closed) and the hasher must not have blocked the sender (HasherFriendMap.Ignore). The sender's own devices ARE included (the echo drives the delivered tick; James 2026-09-18). May be empty. HC6.UserMayEnterChatRoom is evaluated per hasher in the WHERE (line 320).

columns.name: BadgeTotal
columns.description: HC6.UserUnreadChatTotal for the recipient (app-icon badge); NULL when no device with that token is on a build >= HC6.MinBuildForIconBadge().

rowsets.name: SilentPushRecipients
rowsets.description: [kind 'room'] From hcapp_sendRoomMessage: On success, API ONLY: the same audience with ParticipationState 1 (participate, badges only) — a data-only push. Same columns as rowset 2. May be empty.

[kind 'dm'] From hcapp_sendDirectMessage: Returned alone, then RETURN, on: auth failure (from ValidateAppAuth); 2010 missing messageId/threadId/content (errorType 2); 2011 content over 4,000 (2); 2012 bad message kind (2); 2013 thread not open for the sender — 'You can't message <name>.' (3); 2014 unhandled error in the write transaction (5).

rowsets.name: Message
rowsets.description: [kind 'dm'] From hcapp_sendDirectMessage: On success: the message in the flutter_chat_core shape the chat page reads for every thread kind. One row.

columns.name: id
columns.description: UPPER(EventMessage.id). Uppercase on purpose — the client lowercases on arrival (HcId).

columns.name: type
columns.description: Always 'text' — even for a photo or location; messageKind carries the kind.

columns.name: text
columns.description: EventMessage.MessageContent — the raw content (text, photo URL or map link).

columns.name: sequenceCount
columns.description: EventMessage.MessageSequenceCount, assigned by HC.trgCreateSeqNum per ThreadId.

columns.name: canDelete
columns.description: Always 1 — it is the sender's own message.

rowsets.name: PushDetail
rowsets.description: [kind 'dm'] From hcapp_sendDirectMessage: On success, API ONLY (stripped before the reply): what the shim needs to build the push. One row. Inside the log-and-swallow TRY — absent, with rowsets 2–3, if that section fails (logged as 'Push plumbing failed in sendDirectMessage (message was sent)').

columns.name: MessageTitle
columns.description: The sender's DisplayName (a DM push is titled by who sent it).

rowsets.name: VisibleRecipients
rowsets.description: [kind 'dm'] From hcapp_sendDirectMessage: On success, API ONLY: the other party's live devices (removed 0, FcmToken present, LastLogin within 180 days, build >= HC6.MinBuildForDmPush()) when their FriendNotificationPreference for the thread is neither 2 (none) nor 3 (muted). Empty when it is 2 or 3, or they have no qualifying device. The sender's own devices are NOT included (unlike kennel/event/room sends).

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: Device.UserId — the other party's internal Hasher.id.

columns.name: BadgeTotal
columns.description: HC6.UserUnreadChatTotal for the recipient; NULL when the device's build is below HC6.MinBuildForIconBadge().

rowsets.name: SilentRecipients
rowsets.description: [kind 'dm'] From hcapp_sendDirectMessage: On success, API ONLY: the same devices when the other party's FriendNotificationPreference is 3 (muted the thread) — a data-only push so the badge moves. Same columns as rowset 2.

rowsets.name: TrailingSuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Appended by the wrapper AFTER the inner SP's rowsets when an HC.EventMessage row with @messageId exists — index 3 after hcapp_sendEventMessage / hcapp_sendKennelMessage (three success rowsets), index 4 after hcapp_sendRoomMessage / hcapp_sendDirectMessage (four), or index 1 after an inner refusal when a message with that id already existed (a retry). The web scans every rowset for a row with success = 1.

rowsets.name: CatchEnvelope
rowsets.description: The CATCH: { success 0, errorCode 1500, errorType 5 } with no detail rowset (it follows whatever the inner SP had already returned).

sideEffects: EXEC exactly one of HC6.hcapp_sendEventMessage / hcapp_sendKennelMessage / hcapp_sendRoomMessage / hcapp_sendDirectMessage — INSERT HC.EventMessage (HC.trgCreateSeqNum numbers it), MERGE HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts for the sender, and (kennel) may INSERT HC.HasherKennelMap for a first-time poster; see those contracts.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on the wrapper refusal (1230).
The inner SPs' push-recipient rowsets reach the API, which does not fan out pushes for this action and does not strip them.

On an error that escapes the inner SP the CATCH rolls back, logs 'Unhandled error in publicWeb_sendChatMessage' to HC.ErrorLog (HcVersion '<web>', deviceId) and returns the envelope { success 0, errorCode 1500, errorType 5 } alone (no detail rowset).

codeSmells.issue: Refusal log omits the thread id
codeSmells.detail: The 1230 ErrorLog description (lines 45-46) records kind, event, kennel and room but not @threadId, so a refused DM post cannot be traced to its thread.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
